result.title: AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model
result.summary: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. AERIN addresses this challenge with a compact, fixedsize, target-conditioned latent state that separately represents both for efficient action evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that AERIN outperforms the evaluated baselines in target approach and observation quality, while requiring substantially less decision time than similar world models.

AI.brief_summary: AERIN 面向高空无人机实例导航，利用动作条件式视觉世界模型和紧凑、固定大小的目标条件 latent 状态预测动作后果，并调整视角以获取更利于实例验证的观测。
